findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document access. Preserve the tenant equality check before authorizing reads.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant equality enforcement
findings.body:
For any mismatched `userTenant` and `documentTenant`, this authorization predicate now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document reads and exposing tenant-isolated data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before authorizing document reads
findings.body:
When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, this authorization helper now returns `true`, allowing users to read documents belonging to other tenants and causing a complete cross-tenant access-control bypass.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
